Scope & value

Primary actor

Royal Caribbean consumer.

Product goal

Enable consumers to reach relevant cruise results directly from the Royal Caribbean Home Page by selecting one or more relevant search criteria.

✧

Expected outcome

Reduce the friction involved in navigating from the Home Page to relevant cruise options.

＋

MVP scope

* Find a Cruise component on the Home Page.

* Initial unrestricted filter state.

* Destination selection.

* Departure port selection.

* Departure month-range selection.

* Navigation to /cruises.

* Transfer and application of selected filters.

−

Outside MVP scope

* Cruise search-engine implementation.

* Administration of destinations, ports or sailing availability.

* User personalization.

* Booking and checkout.

* Search-results ranking.

* Sorting and pagination.

* Redesign of the /cruises results page.

* Visual design beyond the supplied references and existing design system.
